geometry.address: x+.45y; three broad level regions, no micro-grid
geometry.registration: boundary shape/radii remain fixed; spatial registry front crosses domain

clocks.owner: wall ms; server owns stableactive/durability, no invented permanenttimer/immunity

sparkle.source: separate projected world sources, not attenuated by volume edge nor thresholded from weak integrated RGB

optics.coverage: finite shell density*independent transmission coefficient; optical apertures are not gameplay vulnerabilities
optics.emission: rear cobalt→front cyan anchored toworldZ, white registered source independent; no specular normals or stable doublecontour
optics.incident: source-local light on originalbody, no shape/pose/wholebody multiplier
optics.post: finite17tap/radius8screenpixel nearfilter; explicitpoint-derived apodized crossPSF -26degree in commonEaxis; no invented realcamera optics
optics.IntensityBudget: wide field, clear apertures, localwhite peaks; occupancy/coverage/emission/near/cross separate; no background-specific correction or RGBcap

phases.create: 0–650ms fixed protective boundary is registered across x+.45y, not radialgrowth. two sourcepoints peak165/415ms, full registration by520ms
phases.stable: actualactive snapshot holds fixed field/protective interior. No periodicpulse, ambientparticles or stableSFX
phases.hit: 0–650ms actualsamefield receives positivehit event. Knowncontact lights suppliedpoint and coarse Manhattan-domain response advances through broad registered regions. No invented projectile/direction/deformation. Unknowncontact shows wholefield addressconfirmation at registerednode, not fakecollision
phases.break: 0–480ms spatial deregistration removes broad regions in order; sourcepoints140/350ms; no physicalinwardshrink or flyingfragment. Finalstate solely authoritative snapshot
phases.hidden: dead/ejected/inVent/hidden stops all visual/audio; unsupported variants do not synthesizeevents

sfx.sync: cause once only after GPUready+successfulsubmit, walloffset/rate1;verify gain0/AudioContext0
sfx.design: create carrier+two short spectral registration arrivals165/415ms; hit tight low/mid impulse55ms plus distributed register resonance; break three discrete register releases30/140/290ms with finalhardfinite end

extensions.PostEffects: near and explicitcross from same world sources
extensions.GradientAnchorPolicy: attribute concretization: rear/front depthcolour and white localcauses, no decorative rainbow
extensions.KeywordExpansion: not activated; no registered v/f/o keyword explicitly present

design.acceptance: nativeH64 full/main-only allstages: protective interior and broad digital boundary, clear apertures, front/back volume, samefield receivinghit, discrete registered response and deregistration, point/core/cross genuinely visible. CPUbbox is not visible-area proof; RGB nonzero is not material identity. Separate source/material/incident/OBS/cross gates, clean versuscapture cadence, actualaudio/game/public/adoption separate.
